title.narrative: 225 kV High Voltage Transmission Loop - Bamako North

description.narrative:
The Bamako’s 225 kV Northern Transmission Loop Project (PBNB) has been designated by the Government of Mali as a priority project for the country in the energy sector. Together with the Southern Loop, which is currently under implementation, it will be the main backbone for the transmission of electricity from the main power plants and interconnection lines.
It will help secure the electricity supply to the city of Bamako through the injection of locally produced electricity around Bamako, but also electricity from: i) the electricity network of the Organization for the Development of the Senegal River (OMVS) in the Kayes region to the west; (ii) Guinea through the 225 kV Guinea-Mali interconnection line to the south-west, whose implementation is underway with funding from technical and financial partners; (iii) Côte d'Ivoire through the 225 kV Mali-Côte d'Ivoire interconnection line to the south.
